script: Some planets have two suns, just like in science fiction. One of them, Kepler-16b, orbits a pair of stars. It was discovered in 2011 by NASA's Kepler space telescope. Anyone floating above its clouds would see two sunsets in a row. Kepler-16b is a cold gas giant about the size of Saturn. Follow WonderBytes for more facts that sound fake but are true.
